title: Kill Order
author: Gideon-Strange
selftext:
**I’m an independent developer, and I’m excited to share my newly released game, Kill Order.**

**It’s a spy-themed strategy card game where players compete through tactical decisions, challenges, and eliminations.**

**Features include:**

	**●	Solo play against AI opponents**  
	**●	Multiplayer with friends**  
	**●	Live matchmaking**  
	**●	Campaign mode**

**It’s available for iPhone and iPad for a one-time purchase of $1.99.**

**I’d love to introduce it to people who enjoy strategy and competitive games.**

**App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/kill-order/id6821176831**

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/Gideon-Strange could you please add details on how AI was used to make this? Rule 4 is there to make sure promotional posts contribute by getting into the process and actual development. There's a real risk of the sub being swamped by self-promotion with nothing to discuss otherwise. If you don't update, this post may be removed.

comments.author: Gideon-Strange
comments.body:
I came up with the idea three months ago from a dream. The company I work for started pushing the use of AI.

I purchased Chat, for personal use and asked it one day if it was positive to take this idea and turn it into an app. It said it could and here we are.

I have no programming training aside from back in the old dos days. I have to say that even using Chat for the programming… it wasn’t easy. I have great respect for “real” programmers out there. Hats off to everyone.

I never intended to sale it. It was chat that said it was worthy of submittal. I just planned on giving it ti a few friends to play.

I designed everything. The gameplay. How the matches work, the illustrations, the design, the multiplayer aspect… everything. Chat did the coding.

I’m happy to answer any questions about the process of submittal with Apple.. anything. I wish you all well.
